separateTechnicalAudit.scope: Technical evidence independently reported by slot_inventory; not an art/physical/Mac acceptance gate.

independentBrowserEvidence.method: Independent loopback Chromium; DPR1; live30Hz source viewer and separately labeled paused annotation control; transient screenshot bytes inspected then discarded.

visualFindings.criterion: identity, rose, brightness and small-scale clusters
visualFindings.evidence: Actual 64 CSS canvas light/dark source samples retain the slender dark bill, green upperparts, pale gray belly and rose crown/gorget. Rose remains readable against both backgrounds; interior pale feather pixels remain textured rather than disappear. Enlarged native art supports that interpretation. No large new silhouette hole or conspicuous alpha fringe is apparent at this output size. This does not establish biological scale or fix an unseen app screenshot.

visualFindings.criterion: distinct source changes versus complete wing animation
visualFindings.status: four actual posture keys; full actions held
visualFindings.evidence: Landing visibly extends the toes forward/down, reverse holds a steeper body with tucked feet, arrival folds the wings into a low perch-like posture, and takeoff raises the wings with feet tucked/released. Reverse and takeoff raised-wing shapes are fairly similar; their altered body/foot position is still a real drawing change. Each C airborne posture supplies one wing key only. Playback translates a frozen wing drawing during reverse/landing/takeoff; no flutter should be credited to those C drawings.

The common call-wide head/bill calibration gives a coherent small individual, without fitting wing envelopes. Body pitch, belly shape, tail and head height change across the new keys and old perch; actual-size changes are discrete and cannot be read as a continuous anatomical transition. Existing A flutter has its previously held recovery/smoothness limits. Its phase changes are visible in live samples and do not prove a biologically ordered stroke.

visualFindings.status: technical probes supported; anatomical contact unaccepted
visualFindings.evidence: At actual size the arrival feet are a short dark overlapping cluster. Enlarged feet inspection shows one overlapping foot silhouette; alpha-positive probes [49,79] and [57,79] are two pixels in that cluster. With root [80,122.6666667], their declared projections share plane Y130 and root remains stationary. This demonstrates source geometry, not separately resolved left/right feet, gripping toes or physical support. Airborne keys remain contact-free.

Independent studies visibly reset between keys. Landing endpoint root [80,116] differs from arrival [80,122.6666667] by 6.6667 world units; old perch [80,126] differs from takeoff initial [80,118] by 8.0 world units. Drawn foot/body poses also change. Joining these would introduce a visible discontinuity; they are not approved full transitions. A wings-active supported prerelease key and compatible landing/contact continuity remain missing.

visualFindings.status: visual alignment study useful; feeding held
visualFindings.evidence: The four reused A poses declare alpha-positive bill point [75,51]. Independent projection for all24 alignment samples gives target [110,82] within floating-point tolerance, while root is held. After withdrawal the single reverse key travels16 world units across9 ticks. Point coincidence supplies no flower penetration, bill joint, ingestion or resource-consumption proof. One-shot main tick68 holds; explicit reset/replay is separate.

recommendation: Retain four C drawings as provisionally useful source posture studies, with exact source mapping and residual retained. Do not count complete reverse flight, landing, takeoff, feeding or biological hover. Preserve the explicit contact/endpoint holds rather than splice or fit the art. Owner review and actual Mac yard/intake validation remain pending.
limitations: Actual-size source viewer and enlarged source composites were inspected; actual Mac yard and canonical Sharp admission were not run.

Independent browser evidence comprises16 timestamped state/screenshot-hash observations plus6 extra paired-panel visual observations; screenshots existed transiently in memory and were discarded. No capture bytes/base64/files are embedded in this review.

Light/dark panel screenshots are sequential during live playback and can cross30Hz pose boundaries; before/after states disclose this. They are not matched-phase frames or continuous human-video perception.
No universal body-RGBA equality, identical bbox, identical frame-count or numerical-only semantic quality gate applied.
Source manual eye/bill annotations have native-pixel uncertainty; technical registration pivot is not an anatomical COM or identical skeletal landmark.
External biological videos were not viewed by this reviewer. Source art remains generated candidate material, with rights/fidelity and owner final approval pending.
